messages:
Alex M.: Heads-up — nightly reconciler duplicated a handful of NetSuite invoices for customers in promo_v2. Found 4 duplicates in yesterday's run, pulled logs below.

Alex M.: ```logs
2026-02-28T01:02:11Z INFO reconciler process_batch size=120
2026-02-28T01:02:33Z INFO create_invoice external_ref=stripe:in_2Abc status=201 ns_id=NSINV-2001
2026-02-28T01:02:34Z INFO create_invoice external_ref=stripe:in_2Abc-guid:render_9f3a status=201 ns_id=NSINV-2002
2026-02-28T01:05:00Z INFO create_invoice external_ref=stripe:in_5XyZ status=201 ns_id=NSINV-2010
2026-02-28T01:05:01Z INFO create_invoice external_ref=stripe:in_5XyZ-render_guid status=201 ns_id=NSINV-2011
```

Priya K.: So the reconciler is appending a transient render GUID to external_ref when a price override exists? That will break dedupe.

Matt G.: Yep. Code snippet: external_ref = f"stripe:{invoice.id}{'-'+render_guid if invoice.price_override else ''}". render_guid is ephemeral from pricing service. We should not include it in the external key.

Alex M.: Accounting saw the revenue spike in daily_revenue_agg because NS invoices count directly. They want duplicates voided and a note for audit.

Lena A.: We can void the later NS IDs. Need a formal ticket with invoice IDs + reason text for memo. We also need the Stripe invoice ids to tie to the void.

Matt G.: Plan: 1) Quick hotfix to use external_ref = stripe:{invoice.id} only. 2) Add idempotency check that queries NS by that exact key. 3) Backfill script to find stripe ids with >1 NS invoice and flag the later ones for review/void. I'll open PR and ACCT ticket.

billing-bot: Created ticket ACCT-2031: Duplicate NS invoices from reconciler (promo_v2). Assigned to Lena A.

Alex M.: Can you include a quick rollback plan? If hotfix causes any regressions, we should be able to revert and stop the reconciler job.

Matt G.: Rollback steps: revert PR, restart reconciler service, run safety check to ensure no in-flight creates. Also will add a quick alert: if reconciler sees more than 1 create for same stripe id within 24h, page eng-oncall.

Priya K.: Please coordinate the void and audit note with Lena once ACCT-2031 is created. Also re-run the revenue aggregate for 2026-02-28 after the backfill.

Lena A.: Will act on ACCT-2031 once the list is attached. For memo use: "automated duplicate created by reconciler — transient render key". CC me on the PR.

Matt G.: PR: https://git.redwood/infra/reconciler/pull/256 (hotfix + tests). Deploying to staging now.

Alex M.: Thanks — ping when production deploy is done and when ACCT-2031 is updated. :thumbsup:

Priya K.: Adding to Friday finance sync. :calendar:
